label: exp3

pre_registered_thresholds.source: read from frozen packet preregistered_rules; not hardcoded in the scorer and not retuned

matched_denominator_policy: only cases answered in BOTH arms enter any cross-arm comparison; answerable and unanswerable are never pooled

arm_b_explicit_unknown.note: selecting insufficient_evidence on an answerable case is WRONG, not partial credit

explicit_unknown_detection_primary.note: this is the PRIMARY measurement and the pre-registered test

argmax_selected_insufficient.distinction: this is how often the model CHOOSES the option. The primary rate in (2) is what its PROBABILITY supports. Experiment 1 measured 0.30 here against 1.00 there; the two must never be reported interchangeably.

external_gate_preregistered.rule: act iff p(ground_truth_option) >= 0.86; abstain on an unanswerable case iff max(p(yes),p(no)) < 0.86
external_gate_preregistered.threshold_provenance: carried from Experiment 1, where 0.86 was the best point on that grid; applied out of sample and NOT re-tuned here

probability_separation_DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.warning: descriptive only. This does NOT license moving the threshold, which stays pre-registered at 0.05 regardless of what it shows.

arm_a_forced.note: provider confidence is a DERIVED function of the probability vector (Phase 1 INSTRUMENT-VALIDATION) and is not independent evidence

arm_b_explicit_unknown.note: provider confidence is a DERIVED function of the probability vector (Phase 1 INSTRUMENT-VALIDATION) and is not independent evidence

PRIMARY_ANSWER.verdict: explicit unknown detects 0.9 of unanswerable cases at the pre-registered p>=0.05, against the pre-registered external gate's 0.6 abstention. EXPLICIT UNKNOWN WINS.
